codeSnippet:
// one Cart per HTTP request
builder.Services.____<ICart, Cart>();

explanation.en: AddScoped creates one instance per scope, and ASP.NET Core opens a scope for every HTTP request.

codeSnippet:
// one shared instance for the whole lifetime of the app
builder.Services.____<IClock, SystemClock>();

explanation.en: AddSingleton creates the instance once and hands the same object to every consumer until the app stops.
WebApplication.CreateBuilder sets up configuration, logging, DI and Kestrel with the usual defaults. CreateSlimBuilder is a trimmed version for Native AOT.
MapGet maps a route template and handler for HTTP GET requests in a minimal API.
Injecting ILogger<T> gives a logger whose category is the class name, so its messages can be filtered per type.

codeSnippet:
// throws if IEmailSender was never registered
var mail = app.Services.____<IEmailSender>();

explanation.en: GetRequiredService<T> throws InvalidOperationException when nothing is registered; GetService<T> would quietly return null.
IConfiguration is registered by the host and merges every configuration source; a colon walks into nested sections.
GetSection returns the sub-tree under a key, and keys inside it are relative ("Host" instead of "Smtp:Host"). GetRequiredSection does the same but throws if the section is missing.
services.Configure<T>(section) binds the section to T and makes it available as IOptions<T>, IOptionsSnapshot<T> and IOptionsMonitor<T>.
Outside a request there is no scope, and resolving a scoped service from the root provider is an error in Development. CreateScope makes one and disposes its services at the end of the using block.
BackgroundService implements IHostedService and calls ExecuteAsync once the host starts, cancelling the token on shutdown. Register it with AddHostedService<Cleaner>().
The static Results class builds IResult values such as Ok, NotFound and Created. TypedResults.NotFound() also fits: its NotFound type converts to IResult, the type of the other branch.

codeSnippet:
// register EF Core's context; it is scoped by default
builder.Services.____<ShopDb>(o => o.UseSqlite("Data Source=shop.db"));

explanation.en: AddDbContext registers the DbContext as a scoped service, configured by the options lambda. AddDbContextPool does the same but reuses instances from a pool.
Remove only marks the entity as Deleted in the change tracker. SaveChangesAsync sends the DELETE to the database.
RequireAuthorization adds authorization metadata (the default policy: an authenticated user) to the endpoint; the authorization middleware enforces it.
